# NHCX workspace tracking

This Git repository is the central task journal for four independent code
repositories: `care`, `care/care_abdm`, `care_fe`, and `care_abdm_fe`.
Their directories are ignored here. Code history remains in those repositories;
task records link their final commit IDs to workspace-wide decisions.

## Setup status

The parent Git repository has Entire 0.11.4 enabled for Codex, Claude Code,
GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor, Factory AI Droid and OpenCode. Entire 0.11 dropped
Gemini CLI, so its hooks were removed. These are agent integrations, not
model-provider integrations; capture depends on using a supported agent.
Checkpoint uploads and telemetry are disabled, and no remote is configured.

To check configuration from a terminal:

```sh
cd /Users/khavinshankar/Documents/egov/nhcx
entire status
entire doctor
```

Agent applications must be installed separately and have `entire` on their
PATH.

## How checkpoints are tracked across repositories

The parent repository is the only checkpoint store. Entire keeps all
checkpoint data (full agent transcripts, prompts, tool calls and results,
recorded reasoning summaries, and touched files) on the parent's
`entire/checkpoints/v1` branch. It attaches a checkpoint to a commit
through an `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer.

- Start agent sessions from this parent folder or one of its worktrees. Entire
  links a session only to commits in the repository where the session started.
  A commit in a child repository never gets its own checkpoint; this was
  tested with Entire 0.11.4, including with Entire enabled in the child.
- Each task ends with a parent commit (the task record), and that commit
  carries the checkpoint. The checkpoint transcript covers everything the
  agent did in every child repository.
- Child repositories have a local `prepare-commit-msg` hook that adds
  `Entire-Session: <session id>` to commits made from an agent session. Install
  or reinstall it with `scripts/install-child-entire-hooks.sh`. Commits made
  outside an agent session get no trailer.
- `care_fe` tracks its own upstream Entire settings, which push to
  `ohcnetwork/care_fe-checkpoints`. Entire is not installed in that checkout,
  so nothing is captured or pushed there. Do not run `entire enable` in
  `care_fe` unless upstream capture is intended.

### Viewing checkpoints

Entire 0.11 replaced `entire explain` with `entire checkpoint ...`. Listing is
scoped to the current branch, so merge task branches into `main` to see them
there.

```sh
entire checkpoint list                      # checkpoints on this branch
entire checkpoint explain <id|commit>       # works from any branch
entire checkpoint explain <id> --full       # full parsed transcript
entire checkpoint explain <id> --raw-transcript  # raw JSONL, incl. reasoning
entire checkpoint list --session <session-id>
entire session list
git -C care_fe log --grep 'Entire-Session: <session-id>'  # child commits
```

Entire 0.11.4 stores Copilot transcripts in full but cannot display them:
`explain` shows only the first prompt, and `--full` prints "failed to parse
transcript". Claude Code and the other agents render normally. For Copilot
checkpoints, use the report script, which reads the same data from
`entire/checkpoints/v1`:

```sh
scripts/checkpoint-report.py <id>                         # summary + timeline
scripts/checkpoint-report.py <id> --reasoning --results   # plus reasoning and tool output
```

The report lists the model, reasoning effort, premium requests, skills
invoked, tool counts and failures, child repositories referenced, and linked
parent and child commits.

### Capture requirements (verified 2026-10-13)

- GitHub Copilot app sessions did not run the repository's
  `.github/hooks/entire.json`, so the same hooks are also installed at user
  level in `~/.copilot/hooks/entire.json`. Copilot loads hooks when a session
  starts. To capture a session that was already running, use
  `entire session attach <id> -a copilot-cli`.
- `feature.manyFiles` made Git write an index without a checksum, which Entire
  could not read ("index decoder: invalid checksum"). The parent repository
  sets `index.skipHash=false` in its local Git config to prevent this.
- Entire 0.5.5 could not parse Copilot transcripts ("failed to parse
  transcript"); 0.11.4 can. The 0.5.5 binary is kept at
  `~/.local/bin/entire-0.5.5.bak`.

## Workflow

After a completed coding task, commit the relevant changes in each affected
repository, write a task record here using `tasks/TEMPLATE.md`, and commit that
record. Existing changes unrelated to the task must not be included.
Parent checkpoints do not contain child repository source snapshots; use the
linked child commits to inspect or restore code.

This parent repository records task summaries and cross-repository decisions.
The code repositories are independent: care, care/care_abdm, care_fe,
and care_abdm_fe. Read the applicable instructions inside each before editing it.

Start workspace-wide AI sessions from this directory. Entire capture requires
installed, trusted agent hooks; do not assume a transcript was captured merely
because a commit succeeded. Run `entire status` to check configuration.

Entire checkpoints are stored only in this parent repository. The parent
task-record commit carries the checkpoint for the whole task, including work
done in child repositories. Child commits get an `Entire-Session` trailer from
the hook that `scripts/install-child-entire-hooks.sh` installs. Do not enable
Entire in child repositories.

For each completed task that changes files:

1. Validate the changes and record the actual results.
2. Commit only the task's changes in each affected code repository, unless the

3. Create a concise `tasks/YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.md` with the request, decisions
   and rationale, affected repositories and final commit IDs, validation results,
   and open items. Include a session ID if available; never invent one.
4. Commit the task record in this parent repository. Do not push automatically.

Use Asia/Kolkata dates. Questions alone do not require code commits. Record
explanations and tradeoffs explicitly; do not claim access to hidden reasoning.
Do not add nested repositories as gitlinks or copy their source into the parent.
The parent tracks summaries and commit references, not child source snapshots.

# Install a prepare-commit-msg hook in each child repository that adds an
# "Entire-Session: <id>" trailer to commits made by an agent session. Entire

# links child commits to `entire checkpoint list --session <id>` here.
# Re-run after cloning a child repository. Existing non-Entire hooks are kept.
set -eu

parent=$(dirname "$(git -C "$(dirname "$0")" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")
marker="# nhcx-entire-session-trailer"

for repo in care care/care_abdm care_fe care_abdm_fe; do
  dir="$parent/$repo"
  if ! git -C "$dir" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "skip $repo: not a git repository"
    continue
  fi
  hooks=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path hooks)
  hook="$hooks/prepare-commit-msg"
  if [ -e "$hook" ] && ! grep -q "$marker" "$hook"; then
    echo "skip $repo: $hook exists and is not managed by this script"
    continue

  mkdir -p "$hooks"
  cat >"$hook" <<EOF

$marker

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render an Entire checkpoint's Copilot transcript as Markdown.

Entire 0.11.4 stores Copilot transcripts but `entire checkpoint explain` cannot
display them. This reads the checkpoint from the `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch
and prints a report: metadata, usage, skills, tools, child repositories touched,
and a timeline of prompts, replies, recorded reasoning and tool calls.

Usage: scripts/checkpoint-report.py <checkpoint-id-or-prefix> [--reasoning] [--results]
"""
import argparse
import collections
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

BRANCH = "entire/checkpoints/v1"
CHILD_REPOS = ("care/care_abdm", "care_abdm_fe", "care_fe", "care")


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def parent_checkout():
    common = git("rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir").strip()
    return common.rsplit("/", 1)[0]


def find_checkpoint(prefix):
    ids = sorted({p.split("/")[0] + p.split("/")[1] for p in git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BRANCH).splitlines()
                  if p.count("/") >= 2 and p.endswith("/metadata.json") and p.count("/") == 2})
    matches = [i for i in ids if i.startswith(prefix)]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        sys.exit(f"{len(matches)} checkpoints match {prefix!r}: {', '.join(matches[:10])}")
    return matches[0]


def show(path):
    return git("show", f"{BRANCH}:{path}")


def short(value, limit):
    text = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"


def repos_in(text):
    found = set()
    for repo in CHILD_REPOS:
        if re.search(rf"(?:nhcx/|^|[\s'\"=]){re.escape(repo)}(?:/|[\s'\"]|$)", text):
            found.add(repo)
    if "care/care_abdm" in found or "care_abdm/" in text:
        found.add("care/care_abdm")
    return found


def report(cp, show_reasoning, show_results):
    shard = f"{cp[:2]}/{cp[2:]}"
    top = json.loads(show(f"{shard}/metadata.json"))
    out = [f"# Checkpoint {cp}", ""]
    commits = git("log", "--all", "--format=%h %ad %s", "--date=short", f"--grep=Entire-Checkpoint: {cp}").strip()

    for session in top.get("sessions", []):
        meta = json.loads(show(session["metadata"].lstrip("/")))
        events = [json.loads(line) for line in show(session["transcript"].lstrip("/")).splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if not events or events[0].get("type") != "session.start":
            out.append(f"Session {meta.get('session_id')} ({meta.get('agent')}): not a Copilot transcript; "
                       f"use `entire checkpoint explain {cp} --full`.")
            continue

        start = events[0]["data"]
        tools, skills, failures, repos = collections.Counter(), [], [], set()
        prompts = replies = reasoning = compactions = 0
        usage = {}
        timeline = []
        for ev in events:
            t, d, ts = ev.get("type"), ev.get("data") or {}, ev.get("timestamp", "")[11:19]
            if t == "user.message":
                prompts += 1
                timeline.append(f"\n## [{ts}] User\n\n{d.get('content', '').strip()}\n")
            elif t == "assistant.message":
                replies += 1
                if d.get("reasoningText"):
                    reasoning += 1
                    if show_reasoning:
                        timeline.append(f"> **Reasoning:** {short(d['reasoningText'], 4000)}\n")
                if d.get("content", "").strip():
                    timeline.append(f"**Assistant [{ts}]:** {d['content'].strip()}\n")
            elif t == "tool.execution_start":
                name, args = d.get("toolName", "?"), d.get("arguments", {})
                tools[name] += 1
                repos |= repos_in(json.dumps(args))
                if name == "skill":
                    skills.append(args.get("skill", "?") if isinstance(args, dict) else str(args))
                timeline.append(f"- `{name}` {short(args, 220)}")
            elif t == "tool.execution_complete":
                if str(d.get("success")).lower() == "false":
                    failures.append(d.get("toolCallId"))
                if show_results:
                    result = d.get("result", {})
                    result = result.get("content", result) if isinstance(result, dict) else result
                    timeline.append(f"  - result: {short(result, 400)}")
            elif t == "session.compaction_complete":
                compactions += 1
            elif t == "session.usage_checkpoint":
                usage = d

        child_commits = []
        for repo in CHILD_REPOS:
            try:
                log = git("-C", f"{parent_checkout()}/{repo}", "log", "--all", "--format=%h %s",
                          f"--grep=Entire-Session: {meta.get('session_id')}").strip()
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                continue
            child_commits += [f"- {repo}: {line}" for line in log.splitlines()]

        out += [
            f"- Session: `{meta.get('session_id')}` ({meta.get('agent')}, Copilot {start.get('copilotVersion')})",
            f"- Model: {start.get('selectedModel')} (reasoning effort {start.get('reasoningEffort')})",
            f"- Started: {start.get('startTime')}; last event: {events[-1].get('timestamp')}",
            f"- Prompts: {prompts}; replies: {replies} ({reasoning} with recorded reasoning); "
            f"tool calls: {sum(tools.values())} ({len(failures)} failed); context compactions: {compactions}",
            f"- Premium requests: {usage.get('totalPremiumRequests', 'n/a')}",
            f"- Skills invoked: {', '.join(skills) or 'none'}",
            f"- Child repositories referenced: {', '.join(sorted(repos)) or 'none'}",
            "- Tools: " + ", ".join(f"{n}×{c}" for n, c in tools.most_common()),
            "",
            "### Parent commits",
            "",
            *(f"- {line}" for line in (commits.splitlines() or ["none"])),
            "",
            "### Child commits (Entire-Session trailer)",
            "",
            *(child_commits or ["- none"]),
            "",
            "## Timeline",
            *timeline,
        ]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("checkpoint")
    parser.add_argument("--reasoning", action="store_true", help="include recorded reasoning summaries")
    parser.add_argument("--results", action="store_true", help="include truncated tool results")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    sys.stdout.write(report(find_checkpoint(args.checkpoint), args.reasoning, args.results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render a Copilot session transcript stored by Entire as Markdown.

Entire 0.11.4 stores Copilot transcripts (the raw events.jsonl, up to the
commit) but `entire checkpoint explain` cannot display them, and its metadata
leaves the model, token usage and touched files empty. This reads the
transcript and reports metadata, usage, models, skills, MCP servers, subagents,
errors, child repositories touched, and a timeline of prompts, replies,
recorded reasoning and tool calls. Subagent activity is labelled and is not
counted as user prompts.

Sources:
  <checkpoint-id-or-prefix>   from entire/checkpoints/v1 (or --ref <commit>)
  --session <id>              the live log in ~/.copilot/session-state/<id>/,
                              including turns after the last commit
  --transcript <path>         any Copilot events.jsonl

Usage: scripts/checkpoint-report.py (<checkpoint> | --session ID | --transcript PATH)
                                    [--reasoning] [--results] [--system]
"""
import argparse
import collections
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

BRANCH = "entire/checkpoints/v1"
CHILD_REPOS = ("care/care_abdm", "care_abdm_fe", "care_fe", "care")
SESSION_STATE = os.path.expanduser("~/.copilot/session-state")


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def parent_checkout():
    common = git("rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir").strip()
    return common.rsplit("/", 1)[0]


def find_checkpoint(prefix, ref):
    ids = sorted({p.split("/")[0] + p.split("/")[1] for p in git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", ref).splitlines()
                  if p.endswith("/metadata.json") and p.count("/") == 2})
    matches = [i for i in ids if i.startswith(prefix)]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        sys.exit(f"{len(matches)} checkpoints match {prefix!r}: {', '.join(matches[:10])}")
    return matches[0]


def short(value, limit):
    text = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"


def repos_in(text):
    found = set()
    for repo in CHILD_REPOS:
        if re.search(rf"(?:nhcx/|^|[\s'\"=]){re.escape(repo)}(?:/|[\s'\"]|$)", text):
            found.add(repo)
    if "care/care_abdm" in found or "care_abdm/" in text:
        found.add("care/care_abdm")
    return found


def child_commits(session_id):
    lines = []
    for repo in CHILD_REPOS:
        try:
            log = git("-C", f"{parent_checkout()}/{repo}", "log", "--all", "--format=%h %s",
                      f"--grep=Entire-Session: {session_id}").strip()
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
            continue
        lines += [f"- {repo}: {line}" for line in log.splitlines()]
    return lines


def render(events, meta, commits, opts):
    if not events or events[0].get("type") != "session.start":
        return [f"Session {meta.get('session_id')} ({meta.get('agent')}): not a Copilot transcript; "
                f"use `entire checkpoint explain --full`."]
    start = events[0]["data"]
    session_id = meta.get("session_id") or start.get("sessionId")
    types = collections.Counter(e.get("type") for e in events)
    tools, mcp, models, skills = (collections.Counter() for _ in range(4))
    failures, errors, repos, model_changes = [], [], set(), []
    subagents = {}
    prompts = replies = reasoning = 0
    system_chars = 0
    usage, shutdown = {}, {}
    timeline = []

    for ev in events:
        t, d, ts = ev.get("type"), ev.get("data") or {}, ev.get("timestamp", "")[11:19]
        agent = ev.get("agentId")
        sub = subagents.setdefault(agent, {}) if agent else None
        who = f"[subagent {sub.get('name', agent[:8])}] " if agent else ""
        if t == "user.message":
            if agent:
                timeline.append(f"\n### [{ts}] {who}prompt\n\n{short(d.get('content', ''), 2000)}\n")
            else:
                prompts += 1
                timeline.append(f"\n## [{ts}] User\n\n{d.get('content', '').strip()}\n")
        elif t == "system.message":
            if not agent:
                system_chars += len(d.get("content", ""))
            if opts.system and not agent:
                timeline.append(f"\n<details><summary>[{ts}] System / instructions</summary>\n\n"
                                f"{d.get('content', '')}\n\n</details>\n")
        elif t == "assistant.message":
            if not agent:
                replies += 1
            if d.get("model"):
                models[d["model"]] += 1
            if d.get("reasoningText"):
                reasoning += 1
                if opts.reasoning:
                    timeline.append(f"> {who}**Reasoning:** {short(d['reasoningText'], 4000)}\n")
            if d.get("content", "").strip():
                timeline.append(f"**{who}Assistant [{ts}]:** {d['content'].strip()}\n")
        elif t == "tool.execution_start":
            name, args = d.get("toolName", "?"), d.get("arguments", {})
            tools[name] += 1
            if d.get("mcpServerName"):
                mcp[d["mcpServerName"]] += 1
            repos |= repos_in(json.dumps(args))
            if name == "skill" and isinstance(args, dict):
                skills[args.get("skill", "?")] += 0
            timeline.append(f"- {who}`{name}` {short(args, 220)}")
        elif t == "tool.execution_complete":
            if str(d.get("success")).lower() == "false":
                failures.append(d.get("toolCallId"))
                timeline.append(f"  - {who}FAILED: {short(d.get('error') or d.get('result'), 300)}")
            elif opts.results:
                result = d.get("result", {})
                result = result.get("content", result) if isinstance(result, dict) else result
                timeline.append(f"  - result: {short(result, 400)}")
        elif t == "skill.invoked":
            skills[d.get("name", "?")] += 1
            timeline.append(f"- {who}skill loaded: `{d.get('name')}` from {d.get('path')} "
                            f"({len(d.get('content', ''))} chars)")
        elif t == "subagent.started":
            sub.update(name=d.get("agentDisplayName"), type=d.get("agentType"), model=d.get("model"),
                       description=d.get("agentDescription"), status="running")
            timeline.append(f"- {who}started: {d.get('agentType')} — {d.get('agentDescription')}")
        elif t in ("subagent.completed", "subagent.failed"):
            sub.update(status=t.split(".")[1], tools=d.get("totalToolCalls"), tokens=d.get("totalTokens"),
                       ms=d.get("durationMs"), error=d.get("error"))
            timeline.append(f"- {who}{t.split('.')[1]} ({d.get('totalToolCalls')} tool calls, "
                            f"{d.get('totalTokens')} tokens){': ' + d['error'] if d.get('error') else ''}")
        elif t == "session.model_change" and not agent:
            model_changes.append(f"{ts} → {d.get('newModel')} ({d.get('reasoningEffort')})")
        elif t == "session.error":
            errors.append(f"{ts} {who}{short(d.get('message'), 200)}")
        elif t == "session.usage_checkpoint":
            usage = d
        elif t == "session.shutdown":
            shutdown = d

    tokens = shutdown.get("tokenDetails") or {}
    out = [
        f"- Session: `{session_id}` ({meta.get('agent', 'Copilot CLI')}, Copilot {start.get('copilotVersion')})",
        f"- Model at start: {start.get('selectedModel')} (reasoning effort {start.get('reasoningEffort')}); "
        f"replies by model: {', '.join(f'{m}×{c}' for m, c in models.most_common()) or 'n/a'}",
        f"- Model changes: {'; '.join(model_changes) or 'none'}",
        f"- Started: {start.get('startTime')}; last event: {events[-1].get('timestamp')}; events: {len(events)}",
        f"- User prompts: {prompts}; replies: {replies} ({reasoning} messages with recorded reasoning, "
        f"incl. subagents); tool calls: {sum(tools.values())} ({len(failures)} failed); "
        f"context compactions: {types['session.compaction_complete']}",
        f"- Premium requests: {usage.get('totalPremiumRequests', shutdown.get('totalPremiumRequests', 'n/a'))}"
        + (f"; tokens in/out/cache-read/cache-write: " + "/".join(
            str((tokens.get(k) or {}).get("tokenCount", 0)) for k in ("input", "output", "cache_read", "cache_write"))
           if tokens else " (token totals are only logged at session end)"),
        f"- System prompt and instructions captured: {system_chars} chars (show with --system)",
        f"- Skills loaded: {', '.join(skills) or 'none'}",
        f"- MCP servers: {', '.join(f'{s}×{c}' for s, c in mcp.most_common()) or 'none'}",
        f"- Child repositories referenced: {', '.join(sorted(repos)) or 'none'}",
        "- Tools: " + ", ".join(f"{n}×{c}" for n, c in tools.most_common()),
        "- Event types: " + ", ".join(f"{n}×{c}" for n, c in sorted(types.items())),
        "",
        "### Subagents",
        "",
        *([f"- {s.get('name')} ({s.get('type')}, {s.get('model')}): {s.get('status')}; "
           f"{s.get('tools')} tool calls, {s.get('tokens')} tokens, {s.get('ms')} ms"
           f"{'; ' + s['error'] if s.get('error') else ''}" for s in subagents.values()] or ["- none"]),
        "",
        "### Errors",
        "",
        *([f"- {e}" for e in errors] or ["- none"]),
        "",
        "### Parent commits",
        "",
        *(f"- {line}" for line in (commits.splitlines() or ["none"])),
        "",
        "### Child commits (Entire-Session trailer)",
        "",
        *(child_commits(session_id) or ["- none"]),
        "",
        "## Timeline",
        *timeline,
    ]
    return out


def load_jsonl(text):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("checkpoint", nargs="?")
    parser.add_argument("--ref", default=BRANCH, help=f"commit or branch holding checkpoints (default {BRANCH})")
    parser.add_argument("--session", help="read the live transcript of this Copilot session")
    parser.add_argument("--transcript", help="read this Copilot events.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--reasoning", action="store_true", help="include recorded reasoning")
    parser.add_argument("--results", action="store_true", help="include truncated tool results")
    parser.add_argument("--system", action="store_true", help="include the system prompt and instructions")
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    if sum(map(bool, (opts.checkpoint, opts.session, opts.transcript))) != 1:
        parser.error("give exactly one of: checkpoint, --session, --transcript")

    if opts.checkpoint:
        cp = find_checkpoint(opts.checkpoint, opts.ref)
        shard = f"{cp[:2]}/{cp[2:]}"
        top = json.loads(git("show", f"{opts.ref}:{shard}/metadata.json"))
        commits = git("log", "--all", "--format=%h %ad %s", "--date=short", f"--grep=Entire-Checkpoint: {cp}").strip()
        out = [f"# Checkpoint {cp}", ""]
        for session in top.get("sessions", []):
            meta = json.loads(git("show", f"{opts.ref}:{session['metadata'].lstrip('/')}"))
            events = load_jsonl(git("show", f"{opts.ref}:{session['transcript'].lstrip('/')}"))
            out += render(events, meta, commits, opts) + [""]
    else:
        path = opts.transcript or os.path.join(SESSION_STATE, opts.session, "events.jsonl")
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            events = load_jsonl(f.read())
        sid = opts.session or (events[0].get("data") or {}).get("sessionId", "") if events else ""
        commits = ""
        if sid:
            try:
                commits = git("log", "--all", "--format=%h %ad %s", "--date=short",
                              f"--grep=Entire-Session: {sid}").strip()
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                pass
        out = [f"# Live transcript {path}", ""] + render(events, {"session_id": sid}, commits, opts)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY

#!/bin/sh
# Fast-forward main to the commit just made on a task branch, so that
# `entire checkpoint list` on main shows its checkpoint. Called from the parent
# repository's post-commit hook after Entire's own post-commit step. It never
# creates merge commits, never pushes and never fails the commit.
#
# Disable with: git config nhcx.autoFastForwardMain false

target=main

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_PREFIX

[ "$(git config --bool nhcx.autoFastForwardMain)" = false ] && exit 0

branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD) || exit 0
[ "$branch" = "$target" ] && exit 0
git show-ref --verify -q "refs/heads/$target" || exit 0

warn() { echo "ff-main: $* main was not updated." >&2; exit 0; }

git merge-base --is-ancestor "$target" HEAD ||
	warn "$target has commits that $branch lacks; merge or rebase manually."

main_wt=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk -v ref="refs/heads/$target" '
	/^worktree / { wt = substr($0, 10) }
	$0 == "branch " ref { print wt; exit }')

if [ -z "$main_wt" ]; then
	git update-ref -m "ff-main: fast-forward to $branch" \
		"refs/heads/$target" HEAD "$(git rev-parse "$target")" ||
		warn "update-ref failed."
elif [ -n "$(git -C "$main_wt" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then
	warn "$main_wt has uncommitted changes."
else
	git -C "$main_wt" merge --ff-only -q "$branch" ||
		warn "fast-forward in $main_wt failed."
fi

echo "ff-main: $target -> $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) ($branch)" >&2
